h1: A Children’s Book Has to Work for Two Audiences at Once
intro: Children need a story they want to enter. Adults need a book they trust enough to put in a child’s hands. Authors Crew helps bring writing, illustration, layout, and publishing together so both parts of that decision feel intentional.

faqTitle: Still Have Questions? We’re Here to Help
faqIntro: We make the writing and publishing process easy to understand from the start.

faq.q: Do I need a completed manuscript?
faq.a: No. You can approach us with a finished manuscript, rough concept, or children’s book idea. We can determine what level of development your project needs.

faq.q: Do you provide children's book illustrations?
faq.a: Yes. We can develop custom illustrations based on your story, characters, target audience, and preferred visual direction.

faq.q: Can you help with the book cover?
faq.a: Yes. Your cover can be developed as part of the overall visual identity of your children’s book.

faq.q: Can you format my children's book for publishing?
faq.a: Yes. We can prepare the interior layout and files according to the requirements of your selected publishing route.

faq.q: Can you publish my children's book?
faq.a: We provide publishing support and can help guide you through the preparation and publishing process.

faq.q: I already have illustrations. Can you still help?
faq.a: Yes. If you already have artwork, we can assess your existing materials and determine which publishing, formatting, design, or production services you need.
